'''Kesin Ommis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Coruscanti/Legends|native]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Ommis joined the Rebellion about a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], serving as a skilled [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. His longest tenure came aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Tharen]]'' before he was assigned to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Ommis fought in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] as the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] tailgunner for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]]. Ommis was wounded in the battle but survived.

==Biography==
Kesin Ommis was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Warfare" /> the longstanding [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] and the seat of power of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{C|"Coruscant"}}</ref> Ommis joined the revolutionary [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], about a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the Rebellion's monumental victory in destroying the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|74|Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth}}</ref> He<ref name="Hoth Limited">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Rogue Gunner}}</ref> served as a skilled [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] aboard several Alliance [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]], [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]],<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Kesin Ommis (Snowspeeder Gunner: Rogue 4)|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569524/2013-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-Series-2-498-Kesin-Ommis}}</ref> including his last and longest assignment<ref name="Who's Who" /> as a [[gunner mate]]<ref name="CSWE" /> aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Tharen]]'', before being sent to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters at the secret [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], a remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Who's Who" /><ref name="New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

[[File:OmmisSnowspeeder-ESB.png|thumb|left|300px|Kesin Ommis (cockpit, foreground) fights during the Battle of Hoth in Derek "Hobbie" Klivian's Rogue Four snowspeeder.]]
Shortly before the onset of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="Warfare" /> in which the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] Imperial [[Blizzard Force/Legends|forces]] launched a full-scale [[Ground warfare/Legends|planetary assault]] to destroy the Hoth Rebel base,<ref name="FF5-HOT1">{{FactFile2013|5|HOT 1-6|The Battle of Hoth}}</ref> Ommis was reassigned from starfighter duty,<ref name="Warfare" /> one of several personnel pulled from their regular assignments to serve as a gunner in the aft seat of the Rebels' [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]], dubbed "[[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]]." The move paired him with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> also pulled from starfighter duty, under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Rogue Four/Legends|Rogue Four]]. The responsibility fell to Rogue Group to defend the base against the Empire's invading [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].<ref name="Warfare" />

The Rebels' [[Evac Rearguard Action 101|defensive strategy]] called for Rogue Group's snowspeeders to delay the overwhelming Imperial invasion force as long as possible to buy enough [[Time/Legends|time]] for Echo Base's evacuation [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to escape the planet.<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> Once they received the withdrawal signal themselves, the Rogues were to assemble on Hoth's [[South Ridge/Legends|South Slope]],<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> just beyond the base, where they would then fly starfighter escort for the remaining evacuation transports.<ref name="GG3" /> Ommis was wounded in the ensuing battle, a staggering Rebel defeat.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Klivian's snowspeeder ultimately went down after being hit by AT-AT [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]] and then crashing headfirst into the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of [[Blizzard 1/Legends|Blizzard 1]], Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]' lead walker.<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Nevertheless, both Ommis and Klivian survived the ordeal.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Personality and traits==
Kesin Ommis's combat abilities laid in his considerable gunnery skills, serving aboard Rebel [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> starfighters, and other craft.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> He was also highly trained in weapons operations.<ref name="Hoth Limited" /> When the Rebellion needed to augment Rogue Group's snowspeeders with aft gunners during the Battle of Hoth, Ommis joined the elite [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]].<ref name="Who's Who" />

Ommis, a [[Human/Legends|Human]],<ref name="CSWE" /> had [[Color/Legends|brown]] facial [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin. He also sported a mustache.<ref name="Legacy Collection" />

==Equipment==
Ommis's equipment included a standard [[Rebel flight suit|Rebel pilot uniform]] and a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]] sidearm.<ref name="Legacy Collection" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Character development===
[[File:NotKesinOmmis-SWCCG.jpg|thumb|right|264px|The original Kesin Ommis character image from the ''SWCCG'', which Lucasfilm later established to be Dak Ralter]]
The character of Kesin Ommis was first mentioned on the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/roguegunner.gif "Rogue Gunner" card] from the [[November]] [[1996]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. The card, which established the character's original backstory and role with Rogue Group, identified Ommis as one of the Echo Base Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] appearing in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] during [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] pre&ndash;Battle of Hoth briefing.<ref name="Hoth Limited" /> However, the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery'']] department from [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]], released in [[December]] [[2013]], later changed the pilot's characterization from Ommis to [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] ill-fated snowspeeder gunner in the film.<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref> Research conducted by [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Pablo Hidalgo]] revealed that the actor in question was, in fact, [[John Morton]]&mdash;who played Ralter in the film&mdash;as confirmed by Morton's daughter, thus necessitating the character change.<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsSourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/creating-naming-the-rogue-pilots-clearance-for-immediate-launch/652924968090947|name=[[Tim Veekhoven|Veekhoven, Tim]]; [[Kevin Beentjes|Beentjes, Kevin]]; [[Sander de Lange|de Lange, Sander]] via Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=2013-12-04|archivedate=20200820181312|archivefile=File:BeentjesVeekhovenLange-NamingPilots-Facebook.png}}</ref>

Ommis's background was greatly expanded upon, including establishing him as the gunner of Rogue Group pilot Derek "Hobbie" Klivian during the Battle of Hoth, in author [[Josh Radke]]'s [[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth|''Who's Who in Echo Base'']] article from [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]], released in [[February]] [[2004]]. Given Ommis's pairing with Klivian,<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]], which describes a scene<ref name="ESB novel" />&mdash;deleted from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' film<ref name="Deleted scene">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Complete Saga|scene=The Fate of General Veers|nolink=1}}</ref>&mdash;in which Klivian [[Death/Legends|suicidally]] crashes his snowspeeder into General Veers' AT-AT walker during the Hoth battle, is therefore considered Ommis's first [[in-universe]] appearance, albeit indirectly, in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].<ref name="ESB novel" /> ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', released in [[April]] [[2012]], later established that Ommis survived the battle despite Klivian's snowspeeder being shot down.<ref name="Warfare" />

Author [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|junior novelization]] of ''The Empire Strikes Back'', published in [[October]] 2004, confirms that two snowspeeders appearing in a Battle of Hoth film scene immediately following Luke Skywalker's line "Hobbie, you still with me?" are piloted by Skywalker and Derek Klivian, with Klivian flying as Skywalker's wingman.<ref name="ESB junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> In [[:File:OmmisSnowspeeder-ESB.png|this film scene]], the trailing snowspeeder's tailgunner,<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> which corresponds to Ommis's character,<ref name="Warfare" /> is visible within the speeder's cockpit, making ''The Empire Strikes Back'' film the character's first visual canon depiction.<ref name="ESB" /> However, a live extra for Ommis was filmed during the making of ''The Empire Strikes Back'', for inclusion in the aforementioned scene of Klivian crashing into Blizzard 1. The partially finished scene was officially released as part of the [[2011]] ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'' [[Wikipedia:Blu-ray Disc|Blu-ray]] set.<ref name="Deleted scene" />

===Inconsistencies===
[[File:RogueLeaderDown.png|thumb|left|260px|The ''2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back'' "Rogue Leader Down!" card misidentifies Kesin Ommis and Derek Klivian as Rogue Five.]]
As a result of ''Star Wars Insider'' 146's Kesin Ommis&ndash;Dak Ralter character change,<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> several previously published sources now misidentify Ralter as Ommis in the Rogue Group briefing scene from ''The Empire Strikes Back''. In addition to the ''Hoth Limited'' ''SWCCG'' "Rogue Gunner" card (1996),<ref name="Hoth Limited" /> these sources include ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' ([[1998]]),<ref name="BTM" /> ''Who's Who in Echo Base'' (2004),<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]'' toy line ([[2008]]),<ref name="Legacy Collection" /> [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 5 (2013)|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 5]] (2013),<ref name="FF5-HOT4">{{FactFile2013|5|HOT 1-6|The Battle of Hoth}}</ref> and ''[[2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2]]'' (2013).<ref name="Galactic Files" />

''Star Wars: The Legacy Collection'' featured Ommis in a three-figure set as part of its 2008 [https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCevoRebelPilots2.asp ''Rebel Pilot Legacy Series II''] release. The set, which also included ''Star Wars'' characters [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] and [[Cesi Eirriss|Cesi "Doc" Eirriss]], described Ommis as participating in the Battle of Hoth "as a snowspeeder pilot in defense of Echo Base,"<ref name="Legacy Collection" /> which contradicts the character's role in the battle as Derek Klivian's gunner, as first established in ''Who's Who in Echo Base''.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Although the set's packaging features a likeness of what is now Ommis's incorrect appearance from ''The Empire Strikes Back'', the action figure itself depicts Ommis with a mustache, a unique departure from any previous representation of the character.<ref name="Legacy Collection" /> This article therefore treats the action figure as a valid canonical depiction of Ommis.

The first draft of the ''Star Wars Insider'' 146 ''Rogues Gallery'' article originally listed Ommis as one of the pilots in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' before changing the character to Dak Ralter. However, an editorial oversight in the article's final version left intact certain information that pertains to Ommis, including mistakenly identifying Ralter as Rogue 4 and hailing from Coruscant.<ref name="Facebook" />

Original artwork created by [[Randy Martinez]] for the "Rogue Leader Down!" card from the [[2015]] [[Topps]] ''[[2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' trading card set mistakenly identifies Kesin Ommis and Derek Klivian's Battle of Hoth call sign as Rogue 5.<ref name="Star Wars Illustrated">{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=Rogue Leader Down!|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/112358/cid/7720180/2015-Topps-Star-Wars-Illustrated-The-Empire-Strikes-Back-39-Rogue-Leader-Down!}}</ref> According to ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', Ommis and Klivian flew as Rogue Four during the battle, while pilots [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] and [[Tarn Mison]] flew as Rogue Five.<ref name="Warfare" />
